note: Read 2026-10-30. The eUprava page on the driving licence gives category B from 18; the SPOT portal's entry for the driving licence gives the procedure's cost, issue (or exchange of a foreign licence, or a new category) at 25.85 EUR, and names the administrative units as the competent authority and the Drivers Act (ZVoz-1) as the law. The licence's term wasn't read on a page reached (the Drivers Act on pisrs.si builds its text in script and wasn't rendered), so it is null. Renewals (19.55 EUR; 12.25 EUR for a young driver) and the tests aren't held. The identity card is the ids engine's.
